content: Theia API stability is annotated per-symbol with @experimental/@stable JSDoc tags plus @since. Only breaking a @stable API requires a major version bump; @experimental APIs can break in any minor release without a deprecation cycle. Deprecated stable APIs must survive at least one more major release; deprecated experimental APIs can vanish next minor. Monthly release cadence, quarterly 'community release' for extra stability focus. A product fork must audit which Theia APIs/extension-points it depends on and their stability tag, since defaulting to experimental APIs (the common case for anything new) means minor-version churn is expected, not exceptional.
